result: For EVERY complex rank-four Bob map K:C^5->C^4 whose kernel lies in span{|1>,|3>}, the normalized local compression of the explicit PPT/SN3 grid state R has SN<=2. By its verified exact local symmetry the same holds for kernel lines in span{|1>,|4>}. The outputs are additionally proved entangled, hence SN=2, whenever 4|u|^2>3|v|^2 in the normal form below. Together with the previously proved families, EVERY rank-four Bob map whose kernel vector has at most two nonzero computational coordinates sends this R to a 4x4 PPT state with SN<=2. This is NOT a global 4x4 theorem and does not settle general kernel lines with three or more supported coordinates.
state_and_source: Let [q]=|q><q| and A=|00>+|11>+|22>, B=|01>+|12>, D=|10>-|21>, C=|02>+|34>, E=|20>+|33>, F=|23>, G=|30>, I=|32>, H=|04>. Put R=[A]+[B]+[D]+3([C]+[E]+[F]+[G]+[I]+[H]). Its exact PPT and SN3 certificates are in frontier-20261028-grid-state-five-projections-v1.json SHA256 9863760e2ca2331164d12e62300f3ad7db5b6a17a3ef424e360d504d541004a9. The source range is Krebs–Gachechiladze https://arxiv.org/html/2509.07086v1 Eq.11; 4x5 SN3 was previously claimed there. No novelty or priority is claimed.
normal_form: Up to an invertible output basis, every K with ker(K) in span{|1>,|3>} fixes Bob |0>,|2>, maps |1>->u|1>, |3>->v|1>, and |4>->|3>, with (u,v)!=(0,0). Invertible local output maps preserve PPT and Schmidt number. Denote images under I tensor K by primes. Then A'=|00>+u|11>+|22>, B'=u|01>+|12>, D'=|10>-u|21>, C'=|02>+|33>, E'=|20>+v|31>, F'=v|21>, G'=|30>, I'=|32>, H'=|03>.

case_small.seed: q_S=A'+B'+p F'. Its Alice rows 1 and 2 coincide, and the other nonzero row is independent, so SR(q_S)=2 including u=0.
case_small.twirl: For z in {1,i,-1,-i}, let U_A(z)=diag(1,z,z^2,z^3), U_B(z)=diag(1,z^(-1),z^(-2),z^(-5)) on the compressed output. Then A',B',F' have distinct characters 1,z^(-1),z. Thus T4(q_S)=(1/4)sum_(z^4=1)[(U_A tensor U_B)q_S]=[A']+[B']+|p|^2[F'].
case_small.decomposition: R_uv=T4(q_S)+[D']+3([C']+[E']+[G']+[I']+[H'])+(3-|p|^2)[F']. Every summand has Schmidt rank <=2 and the residual coefficient is >=2.

case_large.seed: For every fifth root of unity z, q_z=z A'+B'-z^2 D'-z^3 E'-z^4 p G'. Its coefficient rows are [z,u,0,0], [-z^2,z*u,1,0], [-z^3,z^2*u,z,0], [-z^4*p,-z^3*v,0,0]. Row 2 equals z times row 1 and row 3 equals -z^3*p times row 0, so SR(q_z)=2.
case_large.decomposition: The five exponents 0,1,2,3,4 are distinct modulo5, hence (1/5)sum_(z^5=1)[q_z]=[A']+[B']+[D']+[E']+|p|^2[G']. Therefore R_uv=(1/5)sum_(z^5=1)[q_z]+2[E']+3([C']+[F']+[I']+[H'])+(3-|p|^2)[G'], a nonnegative SR<=2 decomposition.

coverage_and_ppt: Every nonzero (u,v) satisfies |u|<=|v| with v!=0 or |v|<=|u| with u!=0, including the zero endpoints; at equal nonzero moduli both formulas work. Thus all indicated compressions have SN<=2. Their PPT property follows from R^Gamma>=0 and local congruence with conjugate(K) on the transposed factor.
conditional_entanglement: Project to Alice/Bob output labels 0,1,2. The core range lies in M=[[a,u*b,c],[d,u*a,b],[e,-u*d+h,a]], where a,b,c,d,e,h are unique coefficients and the unnormalized target has coefficient moments sum|a|^2=1, sum|b|^2=1, sum|h|^2=3|v|^2. For any rank-one M and u!=0, minors u(a^2-bd)=0 and u(a^2+bd)-b*h=0 give b*h=2u*a^2. In a separable decomposition, positivity forces every product vector into the core range, and Cauchy-Schwarz yields 2|u| sum|a|^2<=sqrt((sum|b|^2)(sum|h|^2))=sqrt(3)|v|. Therefore 4|u|^2>3|v|^2 proves the core and its parent entangled; combined with the upper decomposition, SN=2. No entanglement claim is made on the complementary parameter region.
symmetry_and_sparse_coverage: The exact local symmetry in frontier-20261028-grid-mixed-zero-three-compressions-v1.json SHA256 25278f1e460330954c54de872f9468b880fa3f3220dbab6c15954852cb139789 fixes Bob label1 and swaps labels3,4 up to signs while preserving R. It transfers the theorem and entanglement inequality to span{|1>,|4>}. The last-two plane was handled in frontier-20261028-grid-all-two-column-compressions-v1.json SHA256 4076912f4e4197244483b47eaa7d6e5d09207386840929db1d04814332ff9406; the four mixed planes {0,3},{0,4},{2,3},{2,4} were handled in frontier-20261028-grid-mixed-zero-three-compressions-v1.json and frontier-20261028-grid-mixed-zero-four-compressions-v1.json SHA256 8db0626df49a83d90f411ab78d3ef48a73ad540f5753673a6195550f5ab17fea. If the kernel lies entirely in span{|0>,|1>,|2>}, A' itself has SR<=2 and the defining nine-term sum already suffices. These cases cover every kernel line supported on at most two of the five original Bob basis coordinates, and in fact all kernel lines within the first-three plane.

verification.observed: Eight exact Gaussian-rational parameter cases: four per regime, including zero endpoints, shared-modulus boundary and complex maps. In each small-regime case all four twirled vectors passed all sixteen rank minors; in each large case all sixteen determinant polynomials vanished identically in formal z, with exact fifth-root coefficient orthogonality. In every case all 256 state entries matched exactly and residual weights were nonnegative. No floating arithmetic.
verification.limits: Finite input checks are samples; the all-complex theorem follows from the displayed row relations, phase identities and inequalities. The entanglement inequality is written reasoning, not a formal/kernel or independently refereed claim.

remaining_gap: General rank-four Bob maps whose kernel mixes three or more coordinates with components both inside and outside span{|0>,|1>,|2>} remain unresolved. No arbitrary 4x4 PPT/SN2 theorem, SN>=3 witness, proof novelty or unrestricted source-priority conclusion is claimed.
